remarks: Space is certainly not lacking in this beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial in the Village of Alden! A huge wraparound front porch welcomes you into the gorgeous foyer and generously sized living spaces featuring hardwood floors, French doors and abundant natural light. The updated eat-in kitchen offers plenty of cabinetry, counter space and a breakfast bar, plus there is a separate formal dining room for holidays, entertaining and larger gatherings. A large first-floor laundry adds everyday convenience. The approximately 18x10 bonus space offers incredible flexibility with its own separate entrance and parking—ideal for an in-law setup, additional bedroom, private home office or home-based business. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite features its own sitting area and an exceptionally large walk-in closet, along with three additional spacious bedrooms. Updated baths and a partially finished basement provide even more usable space. Outside, enjoy the huge yard with multiple stamped concrete patios, an oversized detached 2.5-car garage with 220 line and plenty of room to entertain, play or relax. With impressive room sizes, flexible living options, an updated kitchen and baths, and space for nearly every need, there is nothing to do but move in and enjoy!
